from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyData(BaseModel):
    """A company's share data extracted from one financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    total_shares_outstanding: str | None = Field(description="The Total Shares Outstanding figure as written in the document (e.g. '23,969,148')")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the share count was ascertained or the reporting period end date")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the share count figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyData]
